notes: Three taḥwīl branches (ح) meet at «قالوا، جميعا حدثنا شعبة»; the shared tail is Shu'ba and the back-reference (rule 3).
«بمثل حديث معاذ عن شعبة» names a different transmitter (Mu'adh) for the same saying: a variant group, never a route (rule 4). Shu'ba is its common teacher and is not repeated.
«في حديث غندر ووهب نهي» and «وفي حديث عبد الصمد أن رسول الله ... نهى» are wording variants and are left out.
